# Task (round 3): find the official APPLICATION FEE for international applicants

For every item in "tasks" (school + level bachelor/master) find the application fee (the fee paid when submitting the application; not tuition, deposit, registration or visa fee) on the school's OFFICIAL website.

Where to look
- Dedicated "Tuition & fees", "Fees and costs", "Cost of attendance", "How to apply", "Apply" and "International admissions" pages. Application fees are often listed there, not on the entry-requirements page.
- Fee pages with selectors (country / programme / level): choose Turkey (or "international / non-EU") and the matching level; if fees differ by programme, record the typical one and describe the variation in application_fee_note.
- Fee schedules published as PDF or spreadsheet on the school's own site ("fee schedule", "fees list", "tuition and fees 20xx-xx"): download and read them. Search the school's site with: site:<school-domain> application fee.
- Accordions, tabs and "show more" blocks: expand them and read hidden panels too.
- Official domains only; no agent or aggregator sites. If a site shows a CAPTCHA or blocks the browser, do not bypass it: page_status "blocked" and move on.
- If the school explicitly says there is no application fee, write "none". If the fee is waived for some applicants, give the standard fee and say so in the note.

Output: JSON list, one object per item, same order, no extra text:
{"school","level","application_fee":"amount with currency e.g. 'USD 75', or 'none', or null if not found",
 "application_fee_note":"short factual note on variations (programme, country, early-bird, waiver) or null",
 "source_url":"exact page or PDF where you read it","page_status":"read | blocked | not_found | js_empty","confidence":"high | medium | low",
 "english":{"IELTS":null,"TOEFL":null,"PTE":null,"Duolingo":null}}
Never guess. If you do not see the fee on an official page, application_fee is null.

Submit: POST https://paneledu.com/api/agent/results with header X-Agent-Token: <token you were given>, Content-Type: application/json, body = JSON list of result objects (1-10 per request, send each batch as soon as it is done). Expected answer: {"ok":true,"saved":N}.
